name: contradiction_vs_consistency_mini
description: Balanced mini ASNE contrast for matching versus differing scene information.

consistent_information.text: A person checks a room number in a message and sees the same number printed beside the door.
Someone scans a package slip and sees the printed name match the name on the box.

contradictory_information.text: A person checks a room number in a message while the door beside them shows another number.
Someone scans a package slip and sees the printed name differ from the name on the box.
